targets.query:
tiempos = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "biometrics" and r._field == "elapsed_seconds")
  |> group(columns: ["athlete_id"])
  |> max()
  |> group()

miTiempo = (tiempos
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.athlete_id == "${athlete_id}")
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value

tiempos
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value <= miTiempo)
  |> count()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "biometrics" and r._field == "elapsed_seconds")
  |> group(columns: ["athlete_id"])
  |> max()
  |> group()
  |> count()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "biometrics" and r._field == "elapsed_seconds")
  |> group(columns: ["athlete_id"])
  |> max()
  |> group()
  |> min()

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "biometrics" and r._field == "elapsed_seconds")
  |> group(columns: ["athlete_id"])
  |> max()
  |> group()
  |> mean()

base = from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "biometrics" and r._field == "elapsed_seconds")
  |> group(columns: ["athlete_id"])
  |> max()
  |> group()

best = (base |> min() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value

base
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with pos: 1, t: r._value, dif: float(v: r._value) - float(v: best), tu: if r.athlete_id == "${athlete_id}" then 1 else 0 }))
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["pos"])
  |> keep(columns: ["pos", "athlete_id", "t", "dif", "tu"])
